title: fix(automation)!: switching on a packaged flow that its own status disarms is refused, and the toggle door answers the engine state
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFyg5B2muWbKZjA9phXVWse)_

Refs #34655 (half B; half A follows in its own PR)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md teaches the toggle only as the off switch for an installed package's flow; nothing it says changes

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：管理员对一个"作者已把 status 设为 obsolete/invalid"的打包 flow 点"开启"时，开关不再写入激活账本并谎报"已开启",而是直接拒绝(409)并说明原因;开关接口的成功应答改为回报引擎读回的真实状态(同名 flow 被两个包持有时，回报被切换那个包自己的状态)。
- 为什么改：此前开关写了 `active:true` 却让 flow 继续关着，接口仍回 `{enabled:true}`,管理员以为已开、实际从不运行(卡 34655 的 B 半，分诊要求先落)。
- 风险与回滚：这是一次收窄(BREAKING):对 status 为 obsolete/invalid 的打包 flow 点"开启"由 200 改为 409,并且不再覆盖已有的 active:false 行——此前"先开、再以 active 重发"会直接运行，现在重发后还要再开一次;关闭方向与正常 flow 不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`service-automation/src/flow-definitions.ts` 第 554 行起的新拒绝;`engine.ts` 第 7571 行 host 字面量与第 7528 行起的 `@throws`;`runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` 第 4453 行起的应答读回(只在该名字恰有一行时读回)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/toggle-door-packaged-only.test.ts`,预期全绿且含 "switching ON a packaged flow its own status disarms is refused" 一组;本轮的双持有者应答：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/automation-addressed-route.test.ts`,预期 "the toggle door answers the switched slot" 一组 5 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：作为收窄 PR(Tier H),在审核记录到位后批准落地;#34654 已合入，本分支已合并 main。

## What changes

- **Refusal (engine).** `toggleFlow` with `enabled: true` on a packaged flow whose definition's `status` disables it (`obsolete` / `invalid`, the verdict `registerFlow` records in `flowStatusDisabled`) is refused with `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / 409. It sits right after the provenance refusal (`refuseCustomerAuthoredToggle`), before the ledger write and before any in-process change, so nothing half-flips. No new error code or public name. The verdict is read from `flowStatusDisabled`, now passed in `AutomationEngine.toggleFlowKey`'s host literal, so the status rule keeps one source. The `toggleFlow` docblock `@throws` names the new refusal.
- The sentence (the flow's name and status filled in): `Flow 'NAME' cannot be enabled through this switch: its definition's status is 'STATUS', which keeps it off. This switch never changes a definition's status; publish the flow with status 'active' (for a package that is read-only here, that takes a package version that ships it active). Nothing was changed.`
- **Toggle off is unchanged, on purpose.** Switching a status-disarmed flow OFF still writes `active: false`. Turning off a flow that is already off is not an error, and the row records the installation's choice: when a later definition ships the flow `active`, it stays off until an administrator turns it on. A pin holds this.
- **A second moved path.** Switching on a status-disarmed flow used to write `active: true` over an administrator's earlier `active: false` row, so a later republish as `active` made it run at once. The row now stays, so after that republish the flow is still off until it is switched on again. One-line fix: publish the flow with status `active` first, then switch it on.
- **The door's answer (runtime).** `POST /automation/:name/toggle` answers `200 { name, enabled }` with `enabled` read back from `getFlowRuntimeStates` (the reading `GET /automation/_status` serves). It no longer echoes the request. That reading names the switched flow only while the name has one row there: a flow name two packages hold has one row per holder under the same name (ADR-0150 D4), and the door reaches such a name through `flowSlotView` (its address `/automation/:ns/:name/toggle`, or the bare name while one holder's package is enabled), which switches one slot. Two or more rows therefore read back nothing. In that case, and for a service that does not implement the read or holds no row of the name, the door keeps the legacy echo. For the engine's own service (the only one with slots) that echo is true by construction, because the refusal above stops the one request whose echo was false, on every toggle entry. The handler comment, the route docblock and the changeset say so.

## Tests

New pins:
- `service-automation/src/toggle-door-packaged-only.test.ts`, new top-level describe `[ADR-0126 §7.2] switching ON a packaged flow its own status disarms is refused, and nothing half-flips`:
  - status `obsolete` and status `invalid`: code `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and status 409, the status named. `setActive` is never called, the ledger stays empty, the `/_status` row is unchanged, the trigger stays unbound and `execute` answers `FLOW_DISABLED`.
  - Off both ways (ledger row and status): refused, and the row is unchanged.
  - Toggle off: accepted, the row is written, and the flow stays off after a republish as `active`.
  - The named step completes: republished `active`, the switch arms it.
  - CONTROL, status `active` and status `draft`: off and on work as before.
- `runtime/src/domains/automation-toggle-caller.test.ts`, new top-level describe `[ADR-0126 §7.2] the toggle door answers the engine state, not the request`:
  - Enable request over a service whose state reads off: `{enabled:false}`, which equals `/_status`.
  - Disable request over a service whose state reads on: `{enabled:true}`.
  - CONTROL: state and request agree.
  - A service without `getFlowRuntimeStates`: the legacy echo.
- `runtime/src/domains/automation-addressed-route.test.ts`, new top-level describe `[ADR-0126 §7.2] the toggle door answers the switched slot, on a name two packages hold` (real dispatcher, real `SchemaRegistry`, an engine double that keeps each slot's state and reads one row per slot under the bare name, in registration order). Each case switches the holder registered SECOND, with the first holder's row reading the opposite state:
  - ON at the second holder's address, the first holder off: `200 {enabled: true}`, equal to that slot's state.
  - OFF at the second holder's address, the first holder on: `200 {enabled: false}`.
  - The bare name whose one served holder is the second registered (the first package disabled, its slot off): `200 {enabled: true}`, through `toggleFlowSlot`, the bare `toggleFlow` never called.
  - CONTROL: the first holder's address, the second reading the opposite: the answer is the first holder's own state.
  - CONTROL: a name one package holds still answers its one row read back, not the request.

Existing tests whose behaviour changed, each named:
- `service-automation/src/flow-activation-ledger.test.ts`, case "a STATUS-disabled subflow gets a remedy through its definition — this switch never moves a status". It asserted that `toggleFlow('shared_step', true)` resolves and the child still answers `FLOW_DISABLED`. It now asserts the toggle rejects with `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / 409, and the child still answers `FLOW_DISABLED`.
- `service-automation/src/flow-activation-late-trigger.test.ts`, case "re-enabling the LEDGER bit of a flow whose STATUS is obsolete does not arm it". It is renamed "switching ON a flow whose STATUS is obsolete is refused before the ledger write, and it stays unarmed". The toggle now rejects with `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / 409, and the unbound, `enabled:false`, `FLOW_DISABLED` assertions are unchanged.

The runtime toggle test file gains a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'`, which `check:test-source-alias` asks for (the same line its sibling tests carry).

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing tier: narrowing (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, BREAKING), handed to the seat as Tier H.** The changeset carries the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no schema key, value, metadata type or stored row moves, only one REST door's answer.
- **#34654 has landed; this branch has taken it.** That PR also edited `engine.ts`. This PR touches only two spots there, the `toggleFlowKey` host literal and the `toggleFlow` docblock (now near lines 7528 and 7571). `origin/main` e9f65a3b57, which carries #34654, merged into this branch cleanly in fix round 1 (merge 8eee7ddbe2).
- Half A (a packaged flow that declares it ships switched off) is not in this PR. It is a new authorable key and gets its own PR and contract review.
- The engine's arming gate in `activateFlowTrigger` still declines any flow that may not run. The toggle no longer reaches it with a status-disarmed flow switched on.

- **Fix round 1 (L1 REWORK 6948915409), by seat 3:**
  - **M1 fixed.** The read-back picked the first row of the name, which on a name two packages hold is the first-registered holder's, so switching the other holder (at its address, or bare with one served holder left) answered the wrong package's state. The door now reads back only a name's one row; with two or more rows it echoes, which every engine toggle entry makes true. A fix inside `flowSlotView` was not taken: the engine's rows carry no slot key, so a view cannot tell its own row apart without a new engine member, outside this PR's claimed surface.
  - **Pins:** the five cases above. **Ablation** (fix reverted to `rows[0]`): 3 of 65 red, exactly the three second-holder cases; both CONTROLs green.
  - **Real stack, measured once and not committed:** a throwaway step appended to the Q4 case of `packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-name-per-namespace.dogfood.test.ts` (alpha's `qa_ns_q4` off, theta's installed second). With the fix, `POST /automation/theta/qa_ns_q4/toggle {enabled:true}` answered `{enabled:true}` and `getFlowRuntimeStates` read two `qa_ns_q4` rows `[false, true]`. With the fix reverted and `@objectstack/runtime` rebuilt (marker proven in `dist/`), the same call answered `{"name":"qa_ns_q4","enabled":false}`, alpha's row, the scenario L1 described. Restored, rebuilt, marker proven absent.
  - **S1:** the withdrawn contract-review routing line (review#1, stamped 12:31Z) is removed.
  - `origin/main` merged (it carries #34654), clean; overlap-check VERDICT clean.
  - Full dogfood battery on head 8eee7ddbe2: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 479 passed / 3 skipped (482), Tests 4067 passed / 68 skipped (4135). Readings in Verification.

## Verification

- Door pins on 5b5f2e6b38: `automation-addressed-route.test.ts` + `automation-toggle-caller.test.ts`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 65 passed (65), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): anchor `const state = rows.length === 1 ? rows[0] : undefined;` replaced by `const state = rows[0];`, anchor 1 to 0, blob a1367e7548b8 to b7aa5bd21d9a. Same two files: Tests 3 failed / 62 passed, `VERDICT command-exit 1`. Red: ON at the second holder's address, OFF at the second holder's address, the bare name with the second holder served. Green: both CONTROLs. Restored: blob == HEAD a1367e7548b8, `git diff HEAD` empty. The suites import the door by relative path, so no `dist/` sits between mutation and run.
- Real-stack probe (throwaway, not committed), Q4 case of `flow-name-per-namespace.dogfood.test.ts` on 8eee7ddbe2: with the fix, Tests 10 passed (10). Fix reverted (blob 65e6a60baddd to 08a723a102aa), `@objectstack/runtime` rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `dist/`: Tests 1 failed / 9 passed, `{"success":true,"data":{"name":"qa_ns_q4","enabled":false}}` against expected `enabled: true`. Restored to HEAD blob, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0; probe removed, `git status` clean.
- On 8eee7ddbe2: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 613 passed (613), Tests 11417 passed / 23 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: Test Files 287 passed (287), Tests 4139 passed (4139). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck`: exit 0.
- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard, no path) on 8eee7ddbe2: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 479 passed / 3 skipped (482), Tests 4067 passed / 68 skipped (4135).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on 8eee7ddbe2: 75 families, each run with stdin from /dev/null. 73 exit 0 on the first sweep. `check:type-check-debt` answered queue-timeout (exit 99 inside, PREREQUISITE NOT MET 3) while the battery held the lock; rerun under the lock: exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (3, no dist for some packages); after the full package build, exit 0. `--ran` with exit codes: 75 derived, 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

Premise re-measured on `origin/main` f6f5b50a05 before the change, with throwaway tests, since deleted:
- Engine, packaged flow with a record-change trigger and a ledger, `toggleFlow(f, true)`: for `obsolete` and `invalid` the call resolved, a row `active:true` was written, the flow read enabled false, the trigger stayed unbound and `execute` answered `FLOW_DISABLED`. For `active` and `draft` (CONTROL) the flow read enabled true and the trigger was bound.
- Door: 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"name":"f","enabled":true}}`, while `GET /automation/_status` read `enabled:false`.

`git merge-tree --write-tree` of head a65f6b41fb against #34654's head `8598c1dcb77d7865c91fac5e967d1df84ed44d7d`: exit 0, clean, tree 85297242129540c331add7b00258ba97dda41841.

- Refusal removed (`if (enabled && this.flowStatusDisabled.get(name) === true) {` changed to `if (false && …`), anchor 1 to 0, blob d82d74740f6a to 2e5b155587b8. Result: `toggle-door-packaged-only` + `flow-activation-ledger` 5 failed / 63 passed. Red: both status pins, the both-ways pin, the step-completes pin and the existing ledger subflow case. The toggle-off pin and both CONTROLs stayed green, as expected. Restored to d82d74740f6a.
- Door read-back removed (the answer back to `deps.success({ name, enabled })`), anchor 1 to 0, blob 66105af9556e to 3fe21d164cbd. Result: `automation-toggle-caller` 2 failed / 4 passed. Red: both disagreeing-state pins. The CONTROL and the no-read-method echo pin stayed green. Restored to 66105af9556e.

Both suites import the source under test by relative path, so no `dist/` sits between the mutation and the run.
